blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated multilingual capabilities across diverse language generation and understanding tasks. Yet effective code-switching requires more than multilingual proficiency: models must decide when, where, and why to switch languages in ways that fit the surrounding context. This context-sensitive ability remains insufficiently evaluated. We introduce CSWBench, a benchmark for evaluating context-sensitive code-switching in creative writing through two complementary settings: Focused Narrative and Extended Narrative. We further propose CSWEval, a theory-informed framework with two complementary levels: event-level evaluation of Licensing, Contextual Appropriateness, and Functional Gain, and whole-text evaluation of task-specific quality---overall literary and narrative quality in Focused Narrative and quality emphasizing multilingual organization in Extended Narrative. Evaluating twelve LLMs, we find that models exhibit meaningful but uneven code-switching competence across narrative contexts. Model differences are particularly pronounced in multilingual literary integration, while multilingual-focused dimensions show stronger difficulty effects overall than the general narrative dimensions; narratively salient switches are associated with stronger contextual and functional realization; and event-level CS quality is moderately associated with whole-text performance.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Code-switching (CS) refers to the alternation between two or more languages or language varieties within the same interaction or discourse Gardner-Chloros (2009) ; Bullock and Toribio (2009) . Its meaning depends on social and conversational context, serving identity expression, relationship negotiation, interlocutor accommodation, and affective communication Gumperz (1982) ; De Fina (2007) ; Ladegaard (2018) ; Giles et al. (1991) . Such context-sensitive language choices are also common in contemporary digital communication, where they serve a range of communicative and pragmatic functions Bali et al. (2014) ; Rudra et al. (2016) ; Rijhwani et al. (2017) .
blocks.zh: 代码切换(CS)指两种或两种以上语言或语言品种在同一种互动或对话中交替出现. Gardner-Chloros (2009); Bullock和Toribio (2009). 其意义取决于社会和对话背景,服务于身份表达、关系谈判、对话方的通融和情感交流Gumperz(1982年);De Fina (2007);Ladegaard (2018年);Giles等(1991年)。 这种对背景敏感的语言选择在当代数字通信中也很常见,它们服务于一系列交流和实用功能(巴厘等(2014年);Rudra等(2016年);Rijhwani等(2017年)。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Illustrative distinction between genuine code-switching and surface multilingual material. The examples distinguish meaningful language switches from English expressions that do not constitute code-switching (CS). A genuine switch involves English use attributable to current speaker or discourse voice as part of an ongoing interaction or narrative. By contrast, proper names, conventionalized borrowings, and quoted or displayed English without active uptake are excluded. The distinction depends on how English participates in discourse, rather than on the mere presence of English words.
blocks.zh: 图1:真实的密码开关材料与地表多语种材料之间的典型区别. 例子将有意义的语言开关与不构成代码开关(CS)的英语表达式区分开来. 真正的开关涉及英语的使用,可归因于当前发言或话语语音,作为持续互动或叙事的一部分。 与此相反,适当名称、传统借贷和引用或显示的英文,而不积极采用。 区别取决于英语如何参与讨论,而不只是英语单词的存在.

blocks.en: Existing code-switching evaluations have largely examined how models process code-switched inputs through downstream NLP tasks, including language identification, named entity recognition, question answering, and natural language inference Aguilar et al. (2020) ; Khanuja et al. (2020) . LLM-era studies have extended this paradigm to translation, reasoning, and truthfulness Huzaifah et al. (2024) ; Yang and Chai (2025) ; Mohamed et al. (2026) . Meanwhile, generated CS has been evaluated for fluency, naturalness, and semantic fidelity Heredia et al. (2025) ; Aksüt et al. (2026) , or against naturally occurring switching patterns Sterner and Teufel (2025) ; Winata et al. (2026) . Yet whether LLMs can make contextually appropriate, functionally motivated code-switching decisions remains comparatively underexplored.
blocks.zh: 现有的代码切换评价主要审查了模型如何通过下游NLP任务处理代码切换输入,包括语言识别,命名实体识别,提问回答,以及自然语言推论Aguilar等人(2020年);Khanuja等人(2020年). LLM时代的研究将这一范式扩展到了翻译,推理,以及真实性Huzaifah等人(2024年);杨和柴(2025年);穆罕默德等(2026年). 同时,对生成的CS进行了流利性、自然性和语义忠诚性评价。 Heredia等人(2025年);Aksüt等人(2026年),或针对自然发生的切换模式Sterner和Teufel(2025年);Winata等人(2026年)。 然而,有限责任管理课程是否能够作出适合具体情况、功能驱动的代码切换决定,仍然相对未得到充分探讨。

blocks.en:
Creative writing foregrounds the context-sensitive nature of code-switching, as literary language choices can be deliberately staged within a narrative Grutman (2024) . Characters’ linguistic resources, relationships, and circumstances provide grounds for judging individual switches. For example, a character who speaks English cautiously might repeat an interlocutor’s English phrase to challenge a claim. Whether this switch is convincing depends on the character’s established language abilities, its fit with the ongoing exchange, and the contribution it makes to the disagreement. Across a narrative, such choices can also shape characterization, relationships, and narrative development Gardner-Chloros and
Weston (2015) ; Baldo and Deganutti (2024) . Creative writing thus makes the contextual grounding, local functions, and broader narrative roles of code-switching observable and evaluable.
blocks.zh:
创意写作预示了代码切换的上下文敏感性质,因为文学语言选择可以在叙事格鲁特曼(2024年)内有意进行. 人物的语言资源、关系和情况为判断个人开关提供了依据。 例如,一个会谨慎地说英语的人物可能会重复一个对话者的英语短语来质疑索赔要求. 这个开关是否令人信服,取决于角色的既定语言能力,它是否适合正在进行的交流,以及它对分歧的贡献. 在整个叙述中,这种选择还可以塑造特征、关系和叙述性发展。
Weston (2015); Baldo and Deganutti (2024) (英语). 因此,创造性的写作使得代码切换的背景定位、本地功能和更广泛的叙事作用可以观察和估价。

blocks.en: To fill this gap, we introduce CSWBench , a benchmark for evaluating whether LLMs can use code-switching as a context-sensitive language choice in creative writing. Drawing on spontaneous and controlled Chinese–English source material, CSWBench transforms screened bilingual records into structured narrative prompts that preserve their interactional grounding while adding limited narrative scaffolding through model-assisted construction, programmatic checks, and recorded screening and refinement. The benchmark comprises two complementary settings: Focused Narrative , which foregrounds individual code-switching choices within their local narrative contexts, and Extended Narrative , which places greater emphasis on the organization and development of multilingual behavior across the narrative as a whole.
blocks.zh: 为了填补这一空白,我们引入了CSW Bench ,作为评价LLMS能否在创造性写作中使用代码切换作为对上下文敏感的语言选择的基准. CSW Bench借鉴自发和受控制的中英文源材料,将筛选的双语记录转化为结构化的叙事提示,保留其互动的地平线,同时通过模型辅助构建、程序检查以及记录的筛选和完善来增加有限的叙事脚手架。 基准包括两个相辅相成的设置:焦点叙述(Focused Narritory),其前身是个人在本地叙事背景下的代码切换选择;扩展叙述(Extendation Narritory),其更强调整个叙事中多语种行为的组织和发展.

blocks.en: Drawing on sociolinguistic and literary theories of code-switching, we develop CSWEval , a multi-level evaluation framework that assesses individual switching events in terms of Licensing, Contextual Appropriateness, and Functional Gain, together with task-specific whole-text quality, including multilingual organization in Extended Narrative. Evaluating twelve contemporary LLMs reveals three recurring patterns. First, multilingual literary integration clearly differentiates models, while multilingual-focused dimensions show stronger difficulty effects overall than the general narrative dimensions. Second, switches that carry greater narrative importance also tend to be more successfully realized in their immediate context and function. Third, local CS quality is moderately associated with whole-text performance.
blocks.zh: 我们借鉴关于密码转换的社会语言和文学理论,发展了CSEWEval,这是一个多层次的评价框架,从许可证、环境适宜性和功能收益的角度评估个人转换活动,以及具体任务的全文质量,包括扩展叙述中的多语种组织。 对12个当代法学硕士的评价揭示出三种反复出现的模式。 首先,多语种文学融合明确区分了模型,而多语种重点维度则显示出比一般叙事维度总体更强的难度效应. 第二,具有更大叙述重要性的开关也往往在其直接上下文和功能上得到更成功的实现。 第三,当地CS质量与全文性能有中度关联.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三:

blocks.en: (i) We introduce CSWBench , a benchmark for evaluating context-sensitive code-switching in creative writing through complementary Focused and Extended Narrative settings that foreground local multilingual choices and whole-text multilingual organization, respectively. (ii) We develop CSWEval , a theory-informed, evidence-grounded evaluation framework that distinguishes Licensing, Contextual Appropriateness, and Functional Gain at the event level from task-specific quality at the whole-text level. (iii) We conduct a systematic evaluation of twelve contemporary LLMs, providing empirical evidence on where models succeed and fail in using code-switching as a context-sensitive narrative resource.
blocks.zh: (一) 我们介绍了妇女地位委员会本奇,这是通过补充性重点说明和扩展叙述环境,分别预测当地多语种选择和多语种全文本组织,在创造性写作中评价对背景敏感的代码转换的基准。 (二) 我们制定CSWEval,这是一个理论上知情、循证的评价框架,在活动一级区分许可证发放、背景适宜性和功能收益,在全文一级区分特定任务的质量。 (三)我们系统评价了12个当代有限责任公司,提供了经验证据,说明在使用代码切换作为对上下文敏感的叙事资源时,哪些模型成功或失败。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Computational Evaluation of Code-Switching. Computational studies have evaluated code-switching competence through several paradigms. Input-oriented work examines downstream prediction and language understanding, as in LinCE Aguilar et al. (2020) and GLUECoS Khanuja et al. (2020) , as well as LLM evaluations of translation and reasoning Huzaifah et al. (2024) ; Yang and Chai (2025) and comprehension Mohamed et al. (2026) . Generation-oriented work evaluates controllability and fluency Mondal et al. (2022) ; Yong et al. (2023) , semantic fidelity and human judgments Aksüt et al. (2026) , and correspondence with naturally occurring switching patterns Winata et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 计算评价代码-开关. 计算研究通过多个范式评价了代码切换能力. 投入导向的工作研究了下游的预测和语言理解,如LinCE Aguilar等人(2020年)和GLUECOS Khanuja等人(2020年),以及对翻译和推理的LLM评价 Huzaifah等人(2024年);Yang and Chai (2025年)和理解Mohamed等人. (2026). 面向一代的工作评价可控性和流畅度 Mondal等人(2022);Yong等人(2023),语义忠诚和人类判断 Aksüt等人(2026年),以及与自然发生的切换模式Winata等人(2026年)的通信.

blocks.en: Recent work has increasingly examined the conditions underlying individual language choices. Minimal-pair evaluations compare model preferences with those of bilingual speakers Sterner and Teufel (2025) , while OLA examines pragmatic cues Oh et al. (2026) and ChiEngMixBench considers community-specific switching conventions Yang et al. (2026) . A broader survey situates these developments within multilingual evaluation across modalities Sheth et al. (2026) . Our work extends this focus to the contextual and narrative roles of language choices in creative writing.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作越来越多地审查个人语言选择所依据的条件。 法律厅审查实用的提示Oh et al. (2026年)和ChiEngMix Bench考虑针对社区的切换公约。 杨等 (2026). 一项更广泛的调查将这些发展纳入Sheth等人模式的多语种评价(2026年)。 我们的工作将这一重点扩大到语言选择在创造性写作中的背景和叙述作用。

blocks.en: Creative Writing and Narrative Evaluation. Creative-writing evaluation treats narrative quality as a multidimensional construct, assessing coherence and reader engagement Chhun et al. (2022) , creativity and literary quality Chakrabarty et al. (2024) , and task-specific writing quality and human preferences Wu et al. (2025b) ; Fein et al. (2026) . Long-form evaluation further examines character consistency and event retention Wang et al. (2025) , as well as cross-scene continuity Wu et al. (2025a) . Building on these approaches, our work examines the local functions of code-switching and the development of multilingual behavior across characters, relationships, and narrative states.
blocks.zh: 创意写作与叙事评价. 创意写作评价将叙事质量视为一个多维结构,评估一致性和读者参与Chhun等人(2022年),创作和文学质量Chakrabarty等人(2024年),以及具体任务写作质量和人类偏好Wu等人(2025年b;Fein等人(2026年). 长式评价还进一步考察了人物一致性和事件保留Wang等(2025),以及交叉场景连续性Wu等(2025a). 在这些方法的基础上,我们的工作审查了代码转换的地方功能以及不同角色、关系和叙述状态的多语种行为的发展。

blocks.en:
Sociolinguistic and Literary Perspectives on Code-Switching. Code-switching is theorized through complementary perspectives on interactional, social, and narrative functions. Interactional accounts emphasize discourse position Auer (1995) and speaker alignment Gumperz (1982) ; Goffman (1979) . Social theories relate language choice to interlocutors, social distance Bell (1984) ; Giles et al. (1991) , identity, and stance Bucholtz and Hall (2005) . Literary perspectives examine code-switching as a staged narrative resource Grutman (2024) shaping characterization, relationships, and textual organization Gardner-Chloros and
Weston (2015) ; Baldo and Deganutti (2024) .

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Starting from bilingual interactions in ASCEND Lovenia et al. (2022) and SwitchLingua Xie et al. (2025) , we build structured Seeds and transform them into open-ended prompts for narrative generation. As illustrated in Figure 2 , our pipeline comprises three stages: data and prompt construction, development of CSWEval , and generation and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 从ASCEND Lovenia等人(2022年)和SwitchLingua Xie等人(2025年)的双语互动开始,我们构建了结构分明的种子并转化为叙述生成的无限制的提示. 如图2所示,我们的管道包括三个阶段:数据和迅速建设、发展CSEWEval以及生成和评价。

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Source and Seed Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据来源和种子建筑

blocks.en: We construct CSWBench from ASCEND’s naturally occurring Chinese–English conversations Lovenia et al. (2022) and SwitchLingua’s controlled CS corpus Xie et al. (2025) . After source-specific normalization, we sample 3,500 records and screen for interpretable interactional context and attributable CS. We exclude records containing only lexicalized borrowings, proper names, detached multilingual material, or quoted or mediated material without active uptake by the current discourse voice. Screening and sensitive-content filtering retain 3,009 records for Seed construction. Normalization and coverage statistics appear in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 我们从ASCEND自然发生的中文对话Lovenia等人(2022年)和Switch Lingua控制的CSecurity Xie等人(2025年)中构建出CSW Bench。 在针对特定源的正常化之后,我们抽取了3 500个记录和屏幕,用于可解释的相互作用背景和可归属的CS。 我们排除了只包含有名的借贷、适当名称、独立的多语种材料或引用或调解材料的记录,而不为当前言论所积极接受。 筛选和敏感内容过滤保留了3 009个种子构造记录。 规范化和覆盖范围统计见附录B。

blocks.en: For each retained source sample, GPT-5.6-Sol OpenAI (2026b) constructs a structured Seed by extracting source-grounded information about participants, topics, situations, and language-use cues. Limited narrative scaffolding, including plausible participant relations, interaction patterns, and narrative pressure, provides a usable creative-writing context without prescribing individual switches. Constructions whose additions are inconsistent with the source context are discarded. DeepSeek-V4-Pro DeepSeek-AI (2026) then validates source fidelity and scaffolding consistency, yielding 596 validated Seeds.
blocks.zh: 对于每个保留源样本,GPT-5.6-Sol OpenAI(2026b)构建结构化 通过提取关于参与者、专题、情况和语言使用提示的源头信息来进行播种。 有限的叙事脚手架,包括可能的参与者关系、互动模式和叙事压力,提供了一个有用的创作背景,而无需指定单个开关。 其添加与源上下文不一致的建筑被废弃. DeepSeek-V4-Pro DeepSeek-AI(2026年)再验证出源忠诚和脚手架一致性,产生596个被验证的种子.

blocks.en: The final sets maximize contextual diversity across the source pool, jointly covering all 14 recorded scene domains and all 11 interaction patterns. Extended retains every scene domain; Focused omits one. Screening, construction, and selection details appear in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 最终的组合在源集合中尽量扩大背景多样性,共同涵盖所有14个被记录的场景域和所有11个互动模式. 扩展保留了每个场景域;焦点省略了一个. 筛选、构建和甄选细节见附录C。

blocks.en: 3.2 Theoretical Foundations of CSWEval
blocks.zh: 3.2 妇地会理论基金会

blocks.en: Our constructs draw on interactional approaches to CS and literary multilingualism. Interactional accounts treat language choice as situated social action shaped by participants, local conditions, and unfolding discourse Gumperz (1982) ; Auer (1995) : “Why this language, by this speaker, here and now?” Literary multilingualism treats multilingual fiction as a deliberately shaped resource rather than a transparent reproduction of bilingual speech Delabastita and Grutman (2005) ; Grutman (2024) ; Baldo and Deganutti (2024) . Together, these perspectives motivate our view of code-switching in creative writing as a situated multilingual choice organized as a narrative resource.
blocks.zh: 我们的构思借鉴了对CS和多语种文学的相互作用方法。 互动账户将语言选择视为由参与者、当地条件和正在展开的言论所形成的定位社会行动(1982年); “本发言者为什么现在在这里说这种话?” 文学多语制将多语种小说视为刻意塑造的资源,而不是以透明的方式再现双语演讲"德拉巴斯蒂塔"和"格鲁特曼"(2005年);"格鲁特曼"(2024年);"巴尔多"和"德根努蒂"(2024年). 这些观点共同激发了我们对创造性写作的代码转换的看法,认为这是一种定位的多语种选择,被组织成一种叙事资源。

blocks.en: Building on these foundations, we conducted an integrative theory review using database searches and citation tracing. The review retained 107 scholarly works and identified 70 candidate evaluative concepts, which were consolidated into six preliminary constructs. Four inform the quality framework, while the remaining two guide evidence requirements and narrative-salience weighting. Search and construct-development procedures are provided in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 在这些基础上,我们利用数据库搜索和引用追踪进行了综合理论审查。 审查保留了107个学术著作,确定了70个备选评价概念,合并为6个初步构思。 4项为质量框架提供参考,而其余两项指导性证据要求和叙事权重。 搜寻和建筑开发程序载于附录D。

blocks.en: These constructs ground CSWEval : three concern individual switching events and one concerns the narrative as a whole.
blocks.zh: 三个涉及个人转换活动,一个涉及整个叙述。

blocks.en: Three constructs underpin event-level evaluation. (i) Participant–world resource grounding asks: Can this participant make this choice? It concerns whether a multilingual choice is supported by the participant’s established linguistic resources and represented narrative world, and is operationalized as Licensing (D1). (ii) Situated interactional coherence asks: Does it fit here? It concerns whether the choice is coherent for relevant voice, participants, interactional context, and narrative moment, and is operationalized as Contextual Appropriateness (D2). (iii) Functional multilingual contribution asks: What does this multilingual choice contribute here? It concerns the semantic, relational, identity-related, stylistic, or experiential contribution made by the multilingual choice within the event, and is operationalized as Functional Gain (D3). At the event level, these constructs assess whether a switch is licensed by the speaker and narrative world, appropriate to its local context, and functionally meaningful.
blocks.zh: 活动一级的评价有三种基础。 (一) 参与者-世界资源定位问题:该参与者能否作出这一选择? 它涉及一种多语种的选择是否得到参与人既定语言资源的支持并代表叙述世界,是否作为许可证(D1)加以实施。 (二) 所在地的互动一致性要求: 这里合适吗? 它涉及选择是否与相关的声音、参与者、互动背景和叙述时刻一致,是否作为背景适当性(D2)。 (三) 多语种功能贡献要求: 这种多语种的选择在这方面有何贡献? 它涉及多语种选择在活动范围内作出的语义性、关系性、与身份有关、语义性或经验性贡献,并作为功能收益(D3)。 在活动层面,这些构思评估一个开关是否得到演讲者和叙事世界的许可,是否适合当地情况,功能是否有意义。

blocks.en: For Extended Narrative, Whole-text Multilingual Orchestration asks whether multilingual choices form a coherent, developing pattern across characters, relationships, scenes, and narrative progression. Unlike the event-level constructs, it is judged over the whole narrative , considering how multilingual choices recur, contrast, and evolve across the text. Operationally, this construct is represented by seven scored whole-text dimensions in Extended Narrative, spanning multilingual organization and general narrative quality.
blocks.zh: 用于扩展叙述、全文 管弦乐团询问多语种选择是否形成一种连贯的,不断发展的跨人物,关系,场景,和叙事进展的格局. 与事件层面的构造不同,它被从整个叙述中判断,考虑到多语种的选择如何反复出现,对比,并在整个文本中演变. 在业务上,这一构思在扩展叙述法中以七个得分的全文维度为代表,涵盖多语种组织和一般叙述质量。

blocks.en: 3.3 Task and Prompt Construction
blocks.zh: 3.3 任务和快速施工

blocks.en: From the pool of 596 validated Seeds, we construct task-specific subsets for Focused Narrative and Extended Narrative using coverage-first sampling over source and contextual characteristics. The same Seed may support both settings.
blocks.zh: 从596个经验证的种子库中,我们利用从源头和背景特征进行的覆盖第一抽样,为重点叙述和扩展叙述构建特定任务子集。 同样的种子可能支持两种设置.

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Seed-to-Prompt Construction
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 种子至临时建筑

blocks.en: For each selected Seed, GPT-5.6-Sol constructs Seed-conditioned content and renders candidate prompts in four-part templates covering a fixed creative-writing instruction, character and scene information, narrative-development guidance, and task-specific requirements. Focused separates character and scene fields; Extended combines them and adds narrative-development instructions. Representative Prompt Cards appear in Appendix L .
blocks.zh: 对于每个选定的种子, GPT-5.6- Sol 构造 以种子为条件的内容,使候选人在四个部分的模板中得到提示,这些模板包括固定的创作写作指导、性格和场景信息、叙事发展指导和具体任务要求。 焦点将字符和场景字段分开; 扩展合并并增加叙事-发展指示. 代表快速卡载于附录L。

blocks.en: The two settings differ in generation requirements. Focused and Extended Narrative target approximately 700 and 4,000 characters, respectively. Focused Narrative establishes a narrative situation, while Extended Narrative requires a developing narrative world with evolving characters, relationships, narrative states, and multilingual behavior. Both settings leave specific code-switching choices and story development open to the model, yielding 855 candidate prompts for subsequent validation.
blocks.zh: 两种设置在生成要求上有所不同. 有重点的和扩展的叙述目标分别为大约700个和4 000个字符。 有重点的叙事设定了叙事状态,而扩展叙事则需要一个不断发展的叙事世界,其人物,关系,叙事状态,以及多语种行为. 这两个设置都给模型留下了特定的代码切换选择和故事开发,产生了855个可供后续验证的候选提示.

blocks.en: 3.3.2 Prompt Validation
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 迅速验证

blocks.en: Candidate prompts undergo deterministic checks for completeness, formatting, prohibited information, and redundancy, followed by two independent human reviews for Seed fidelity, task clarity and satisfiability, CS observability, and creative openness under setting-specific criteria. Disagreements receive third-rater adjudication; correctable problems undergo targeted revision and re-screening. The final set retains 807 of 855 prompts: 407 Focused and 400 Extended, derived from 546 distinct Seeds, with 261 shared across tasks.
blocks.zh: 候选人要接受关于完整性、格式化、被禁信息和冗余的确定性检查,然后根据特定标准,对种子忠诚性、任务明确性和可调适性、CS可观察性和创造性开放性进行两次独立的人文审查。 分歧者得到三等判决;可纠正的问题有针对性地修订和重新筛选。 最后一套保留了855个提示中的807个:407个聚焦和400个扩展,取自546个不同的种子,其中261个任务共有.

blocks.en: The final sets retain diversity in scene domains, participant relations, interaction patterns, and preferred styles. The paired reviews yield Gwet’s AC1 = .975 for Focused and .838 for Extended; screening details are reported in Appendix I .
blocks.zh: 最终设定保留了场景域,参与者关系,互动模式,和首选风格的多样性. 合并审查的结果是,Gwet的AC1=975,扩大部分为838;筛选详情见附录一。

blocks.en: 3.4 CSWEval : Evaluation Framework
blocks.zh: 3.4 妇女地位委员会 Eval: 评价框架

blocks.en: CSWEval evaluates generated narratives at two complementary levels: individual code-switching events and the narrative as a whole. The constructs developed in Section 3.2 are operationalized through task-specific, evidence-grounded rubrics: binary checks applied at the event level for D1, aggregated at the article level as 5 × 5\times the pass rate, and 1–5 ordinal rubrics with dimension-specific anchors for D2, D3, and whole-text quality. The complete dimensions, subdimensions, and task-specific scoring schemes are summarized in Appendix H .
blocks.zh: 妇女地位委员会 Eval在两个互补层面评价生成的叙事:单个代码切换事件和整个叙事. 第3.2节所开发的构件通过基于具体任务和证据的标点加以操作:在事件一级对D1适用二进制检查,在文章一级汇总为通过率的5×5分;在D2、D3和全文质量方面采用有尺寸特定锚地的1-5分正弦。 附录H概述了完整的维度、分数和具体任务评分办法。

blocks.en: 3.4.1 Code-Switching Event Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.4.1 代码交换事件说明

blocks.en: Before evaluation, every contiguous Latin-script span is treated as a candidate CS span. Candidates are classified using the operational CS definition and grouped into events, fixing their boundaries before quality scoring. For Extended Narrative, we prepare character and language profiles, relationship and narrative-world records, and Licensing evidence available at each event for event-level Licensing and longitudinal whole-text evaluation. Annotation rules appear in Appendix F . Human audits examine event discovery and evidence-record fidelity (Appendices K.4 and K.5 ).

blocks.en: 3.4.2 Task-Specific Multi-Level Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.4.2 特定任务的多层次评价

blocks.en: Both settings evaluate event-level Licensing, Contextual Appropriateness, and Functional Gain but differ in scoring granularity and whole-text rubrics. Focused scores each applicable Contextual Appropriateness and Functional Gain subdimension per event and aggregates them into dimension scores. Extended uses these subdimensions as rubric guidance and assigns one overall score per dimension.
blocks.zh: 这两种设置都评价事件层面的许可、背景适宜性和功能收益,但评分颗粒度和全文标题不同。 每起事件的重点分数为每一适用背景的适当性和功能增益分数,并将其汇总为分数. 扩展使用这些子元作为标题指导,并给每个维度分配一个总分.

blocks.en: At the whole-text level, both settings score multiple dimensions separately and aggregate them into an overall whole-text score, but use different task-specific rubrics. Focused Narrative assesses overall literary and narrative quality. Extended Narrative evaluates seven whole-text dimensions: multilingual narrative-system stability (M-F1), the bilingual profiles and language development of two focal characters (M-F2A and M-F2B), three general narrative dimensions covering structure, character development, and prose quality (M-F3.1–M-F3.3), and multilingual literary integration (M-F3.4).
blocks.zh: 在全文本层面,两种设置都分别分出多个维度,并将其汇总为一个整体的全文本分数,但使用不同的任务特定分数. 重点叙事评估整体文学和叙事质量. 扩展叙事评价了七个全文本维度:多语种叙事系统稳定性(M-F1),双语简介和语言发展两个焦点人物(M-F2A和M-F2B),三个通篇叙事维度,涵盖结构,人物发展,和道具质量(M-F3.1-M-F3.3),多语种文学融合(M-F3.4).

blocks.en: 3.4.3 Narrative Salience and Score Aggregation
blocks.zh: 3.4.3 叙述性突出和分数合计

blocks.en: Not all identified code-switching events contribute equally to narrative development. Narratological accounts of eventfulness distinguish events by the extent and consequences of the changes they introduce into a developing narrative Schmid (2010) ; Hühn (2014) . Each judge independently assigns a Narrative Salience level (S1, S2, or S3) to each previously identified code-switching event during evaluation. These levels reflect increasing narrative consequence and correspond to aggregation weights of 1, 2, and 3, respectively. Contextual Appropriateness and Functional Gain are then aggregated across identified code-switching events using these salience weights. Human-agreement results are effectively unchanged under alternative salience-weighting schemes: equal weighting and both milder and more concentrated alternatives yield correlations within approximately .01 of the reported 1:2:3 scheme.
blocks.zh: 并非所有已确定的代码切换事件都同样有助于叙事发展. 关于事件性的叙述,根据事件对变化的程度和后果加以区分。 每个法官在评价期间独立为以前确定的每一个代码切换事件指定一个叙述性显著级别(S1,S2或S3). 这些水平反映出叙述性后果日益增加,并分别对应了汇总权重1、2和3。 然后,利用这些突出的权重,对已确定的代码转换事件进行汇总。 在替代的显著加权办法下,人类协议结果实际上没有变化:在所报告的1:2:3办法中,相等加权和较温和和和较集中的替代办法产生相关性约为.01。

blocks.en: 5.1.2 Construct Sensitivity
blocks.zh: 5.1.2 建筑敏感性

blocks.en: Our perturbation and counterfactual studies test sensitivity to relevant evidence and controlled alternatives to observed language choices.
blocks.zh: 我们的扰动和反事实研究测试了对有关证据的敏感性,以及观察语言选择的可控替代品.

blocks.en: For Functional Gain, we conduct a cross-judge construct-sensitivity experiment on 72 events from 71 narratives, using LLM-generated Chinese-only counterfactuals reviewed and revised by human annotators. We use a reciprocal cross-judge design: one judge assigns events to HIGH and LOW groups based on its original D3 scores, while the other evaluates the original–counterfactual pairs in both presentation orders. We repeat the procedure with the judges’ roles reversed. They determine whether the original CS realization better preserves contextually supported communicative and narrative effects, whether the alternatives are equivalent, or whether the monolingual alternative is stronger (Table 3 ). HIGH-D3 events more often favor the original CS realization, whereas LOW-D3 events yield more ties, consistent with greater replaceability by a natural monolingual alternative.

blocks.en: Position-swap experiments on 36 Extended narratives test whole-text multilingual organization (Appendix K.7 ). We swap 2, 4, 6, and 8 CS-event pairs, alongside Chinese-span controls using the same schedule. Both manipulations increasingly reduce Whole-text scores: at the strongest level, scores fall from 3.702 to 2.901 under CS swaps and to 3.137 under Chinese swaps. CS swaps primarily disrupt multilingual organization; Chinese swaps have relatively greater effects on general narrative execution. This contrast indicates particular sensitivity of the multilingual-organization dimensions to CS-event placement.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduce CSWBench , a benchmark for evaluating context-sensitive code-switching in creative writing, together with CSWEval , a theory-informed framework for evaluation at the event and whole-text levels. Experiments with twelve LLMs show that the main challenges of code-switching generation extend beyond producing locally plausible switches. Models differ substantially in how well they sustain multilingual choices as part of an evolving narrative system, while the quality of individual switches is positively associated with their narrative importance and shows moderate positive associations with whole-text performance. These results motivate evaluating code-switching as a local language choice and as a narrative pattern that develops across the text, with event-level and whole-text evaluation providing complementary and convergent evidence. We hope CSWBench and CSWEval support future research on multilingual generation and code-switching evaluation.

blocks.en: The source-screening prompt first checks P0 (interpretable coherent discourse), then P1 (attributable semantic CS), followed by sensitivity flags. A retained record needs enough context to identify a coherent interaction or discourse unit and at least one meaningful English use by a current speaker/voice. Ordinary oral hesitation is not corruption. English words alone do not establish CS.

blocks.en: • Structural exclusions: corrupt/truncated material, fragments without recoverable context, unrelated units concatenated together, and detached word lists. Co-occurrence of separate monolingual speakers or unrelated units is insufficient without attributable switching. • Lexical borrowing and names: conventionalized borrowings, names, brands, or labels alone do not demonstrate a switch. The source reason categories include BORROWING_ONLY and NAMED_ENTITY_ONLY . • Quotation and mediated material: quoted English, copied material, or static display without active uptake by the current discourse voice is excluded ( QUOTATION_ONLY , MEDIATED_ONLY ). Active reuse can qualify; quotation marks alone are not the criterion. • Other non-CS cases: cross-unit language separation, noisy language detection, English-dominant material with isolated Chinese, or unresolved attribution receive NOT_TRUE_CSW or AMBIGUOUS , rather than being forced into the retained set. • Sensitivity: flagged personal identifiers/privacy, minors-related risk, sexual content, self-harm, severe violence, illegal conduct, hate, or private health information are excluded under the screening prompt. Mere ordinary mention of a topic is not automatically a sensitive case.

blocks.en: C.2 Seed Construction and Validation

blocks.en: The source must support the topic, evidence summary, source-supported possible situation, and identifiable interactional/medium cues. Narrative pressure, a plausible interaction sequence, relation detail, stylistic affordances, and open consequences can be added only as explicitly labeled creative scaffolding . Seed representation is described in Appendix E.1 ; a stored Seed and the construction examples are reproduced in Appendix L .

blocks.en: Seed-stage validation is performed by DeepSeek-V4-Pro using two checks. Gate A verifies that material evidence claims are supported by the redacted source, and Gate B verifies that labeled creative scaffolding remains consistent with the source basis and constraints. A Seed is eligible only when both checks pass.

blocks.en: The task-specific prompt sets are selected from the pool of 596 validated Seeds, prioritizing coverage of scene domain, participant relation, interaction pattern, and preferred style, with deterministic tie-breaking and source-group constraints. For records with available source English-token counts, construction refusal rates across the four source-CS length quartiles range from 45.2% to 54.1%. After Prompt construction, every completed Prompt undergoes independent human screening for grounding fidelity and scaffolding compatibility (Appendix I ).

blocks.en: Appendix D Theory Review and Construct Development

blocks.en: D.1 Search and Selection Trail
blocks.zh: D.1 搜索和选择轨迹

blocks.en: The theory review uses two routes: theory-led citation tracing from anchor works, and a structured bibliographic search. The executed OpenAlex log contains 32 title-and-abstract queries , with publication dates restricted to 1950–2026-06-01, pagination at 200 records, and no initial language or publication-type restriction. It records 1,972 query occurrences, 1,615 distinct OpenAlex IDs, and 1,518 works after version deduplication.
blocks.zh: 理论评论采用两种途径:从主播作品中以理论为导向的引用追踪,以及结构化的书目检索. 已执行的OpenAlex日志包含32个标题和摘要查询,出版日期被限制在1950–2026-06-01,pagination at 200 records,没有初始语言或出版类型的限制. 它记录了1,972起查询事件,1,615起明显的OpenAlex ID,以及1,518起版本分解后的作品.

blocks.en: The executed searches are organized around the two theoretical foundations used in the main text. For interactional approaches to code-switching, the registered title-and-abstract queries include “code-switching” AND interactional AND sequential , “code-switching” AND “contextualization cue” , “code-switching” AND “audience design” . For literary multilingualism, they include “literary code-switching” AND narrative , “literary multilingualism” AND narrative AND function , “staged code-switching” , and “fictional multilingualism” . The complete master log contains 162 completed entries: 32 structured OpenAlex searches, 108 OpenAlex anchor-resolution/backward/forward-chain requests, and 22 targeted scholarly-web searches with direct publisher or official-source follow-up. Google Scholar and arXiv were used for supplementary discovery and computational-comparator location.
blocks.zh: 已执行的搜索是围绕正文中使用的两个理论基础组织的. 对于代码交换的交互方法,注册的标题和摘要查询包括“代码交换”和交互和相继性、“代码交换”和“文字交换提示”、“代码交换”和“观众设计”。 关于文学上的多语制,它们包括“文学密码转换”和叙述、“文学多语制”和说明和功能、“分阶段密码转换”和“虚拟多语制”。 完整的主日志包含162个已完成条目:32个结构化的OpenAlex搜索,108个OpenAlex锚定/后向/前向链请求,以及22个有针对性的学术-网络搜索,有直接出版商或官方来源的跟踪. Google Scholar和arXiv被用于补充发现和计算比较器位置.

blocks.en: The citation-tracing protocol starts from representative theoretical anchors, checks their references for predecessors, and follows citing work for extensions, critiques, and boundary conditions. It records parent source and tracing direction. Its planned stopping rule is two rounds, with an optional third round for unresolved conceptual gaps. Deduplication prioritizes DOI, then bibliographic ID, then normalized title, author, and year, while linking versions.
blocks.zh: 引用跟踪协议从具有代表性的理论锚地开始,为前辈检查参考文献,然后引用工作内容来扩展、批评和边界条件。 它记录了母源和追踪方向. 其计划中的停止规则是两轮,对尚未解决的概念差距可选第三轮. 复制优先处理DOI,然后是书目ID,然后是正常的标题,作者和年份,同时连接版本.

blocks.en: Substantive theory records must contribute to one of the two theoretical foundations used in the main text: (i) interactional approaches to code-switching, which treat language choice as situated social action shaped by participants, local interactional conditions, and unfolding discourse; or (ii) literary multilingualism, which treats multilingual language in fiction as a deliberately shaped literary and narrative resource. These records must expose an evaluative distinction and identify textual evidence that could support judging it in generated narratives. Methodological comparators are retained when they inform review methodology, construct operationalization, or the use of textual evidence in evaluation. Books and chapters are eligible alongside articles. Duplicate versions, unverifiable or non-academic items, and claims requiring inaccessible real-world cognition are excluded.
blocks.zh: 实质性理论记录必须有助于在正文中使用的两个理论基础之一:(一) 代码转换的交互方法,即将语言选择视为由参与者塑造的定位社会行动、地方互动条件和正在展开的论述;或(二) 文学多语性,将虚构中的多语种语言视为有意形成的文学和叙事资源。 这些记录必须揭示评价上的区别,并找出可支持在生成的叙述中加以判断的文字证据。 在为审查方法提供信息、构建可操作性或在评价中使用文字证据时,保留方法参照人。 书籍和分会可与文章并列。 复制版本,不可核实或非学术性项目,以及需要无法进入的现实世界认知的债权被排除在外.

blocks.en: The final convention is 107 retained sources → \rightarrow 70 concepts → \rightarrow six preliminary constructs → \rightarrow four quality constructs . The 107-record union contains 63 theory-led and 44 search-led records, comprising 100 substantive theory records and seven methodological comparators.

A semantic event is a locally coherent English choice attributable to a speaker
or narrative voice and to an ongoing discourse action. It can consist of a word,

discourse action belongs to one event. The discoverer

the number of mechanical spans with the number of events. Accepted proposals are
fixed before scoring, and the quality judges cannot merge, split, add, or reorder
that manifest. Independent human validation of both candidate inclusion and event
grouping is reported in Appendix K.4 .

blocks.en: H.1 Licensing (D1)
blocks.zh: H.1 许可证发放(D1)

blocks.en: Participant/role-level licensing asks whether the attributed speaker or narrative voice has the identity, language history, comprehension/expression resources, and established profile needed for this particular use of English. World-level licensing asks whether the addressee, carrier (speech, writing, inner speech, or active mediated reuse), scene, relationship state, social rules, established facts, and prior discourse state permit the choice. Each check receives PASS or FAIL ; an event passes only if both pass.

blocks.en: H.2 Event-Level Ordinal Anchors
blocks.zh: H.2 事件级规范控制器

blocks.en: The event-level ordinal scale progresses from 1 , unsuccessful or clearly unsupported; 2 , weak or partial; 3 , clear and adequate; 4 , strong and specific; to 5 , precise and highly realized. The operational meaning of these levels is specified separately for Contextual Appropriateness and Functional Gain below.
blocks.zh: 事件层次的平面尺度从1个、不成功或明显不支持;2个、弱或部分;3个、明确和充分;4个、有力和具体;5个、准确和高度实现。 这些水平的业务意义在下文中为背景适宜性和功能增益分别列出。

blocks.en: H.3 Contextual Appropriateness (D2)
blocks.zh: H.3 环境适宜性(D2)

blocks.en: Focused D2 scores eight subdimensions at each event. Applicability is checked before quality, as specified in the table caption. Contextual Appropriateness evaluates how well the multilingual choice fits its local narrative and discourse context. Its 1–5 anchors are: 1 , contextually unsupported or conflicting; 2 , weak or partial contextual fit; 3 , clear contextual fit supported by concrete local evidence; 4 , strong and specific contextual fit; 5 , precise contextual realization, for which the particular wording, form, and placement are well supported by the context where relevant.
blocks.zh: 焦点D2在每个赛事上评分为8分. 适用性在质量前按表格标题的规定检查。 适当性评估了多语种选择如何适合当地叙述和讨论的背景。 它的一至五个主干是:1,在背景上没有支持或冲突;2,弱或部分背景适合;3,在具体当地证据的支持下明确背景适合;4,强而具体的背景适合;5,准确的背景实现,具体的措辞、形式和位置在相关时得到上下文的充分支持。

blocks.en: Table 7: Focused D2 rubric. NA is allowed for D2.3–D2.7; D2.1, D2.2, and D2.8 always require numeric scores. For D2.7, unchanged adjacent register is NA, whereas a required but unrealized transition is scored.

blocks.en: Extended D2 instead receives one direct event score. Voice, carrier, addressee, topic, emotion, power/stance, register, and switch boundary are guidance , not separately scored fields, and the D2 anchors above are applied holistically across the relevant evidence.
blocks.zh: 扩展D2取而代之的是直接事件得分. 语音、载体、收件人、主题、情感、力量/强度、登记和切换边界是指导,而不是单独打分的字段,上面的D2锚在相关证据之间得到整体应用。

blocks.en: H.4 Functional Gain (D3)
blocks.zh: H.4 功能收益(D3)

blocks.en: Functional Gain measures the added value that a code-switching choice itself provides. Credit follows the choice and its local effect rather than the rest of the sentence or scene. Its 1–5 anchors are: 1 , the relevant function is absent or poorly realized; 2 , weak, limited, or largely redundant functional value; 3 , a clear, observable, and locatable contribution within the current event; 4 , a strong and specific contribution that actively does work in the event; 5 , a substantial, precise, and non-redundant contribution that is tightly integrated into the current event.
blocks.zh: 功能增益衡量代码转换选择本身提供的附加值。 信用遵循选择及其局部效果,而不是其他句子或场景. 其一至五锚有: 1,相关功能缺失或实现不足; 2,弱,有限或基本冗余功能价值; 3,在当前事件内明确,可观测,可移动的贡献; 4,在事件内积极发挥作用的有力而具体的贡献; 5,大量,准确,不重复的贡献被紧密地融入当前事件.

blocks.en: Focused D3 scores the five subdimensions in Table 8 separately at each event and aggregates them into the dimension score.
blocks.zh: 焦点D3在每个事件上分别给表8中的5个子分数打分,并将其汇总入维度分数.

blocks.en: Table 8: Focused D3 rubric. NA applies to D3.1, D3.2, D3.3, and D3.5 when the corresponding function is not applicable; D3.4 always requires a numeric score.

blocks.en: Extended D3 is a direct 1–5 event score. The same semantic, relational, identity-cultural, stylistic, and experiential checks serve as guidance rather than separately scored fields, and the D3 anchors above are applied holistically across the relevant evidence. Table 3 and Figure 9 report the separate counterfactual study that tests this construct in both settings.
blocks.zh: 扩展 D3 是直接的 1–5 事件分数 。 同样的语义性,关系性,身份文化性,语法性,经验性检查作为指导而不是单独打分的字段,上面的D3锚被整体地应用到相关证据中去. 表3和图9报告了在两种情况下测试这种构造的单独反事实研究。

blocks.en: H.5 Focused Whole-Text Quality
blocks.zh: H.5 重点全文本质量

blocks.en: Focused Whole assesses overall literary and narrative quality , not Multilingual Orchestration. L1–L5 are five scored dimensions without separately scored children. They require integers 1–5, with no NA/IE.
blocks.zh: 重点 整体评估整体文学和叙事质量,而不是多语种管弦乐团。 L1–L5是5个打分的维度,没有单独打分的孩子. 它们需要整数1-5,没有NA/IE。

blocks.zh: 表9:重点全文本标题. 分数2表示主播1和3之间的部分成功;所有5个维度都需要分数,没有NA/IE.

blocks.en: H.6 Extended Whole-Text Dimensions
blocks.zh: H.6 扩展全文本尺寸

blocks.en: Seven dimensions are scored independently (Table 10 ). M-F2A and M-F2B are separate; asymmetric language use is permitted.
blocks.zh: 七维独立得分(表10). M-F2A和M-F2B是分开的;允许使用不对称语言.

blocks.en: Table 10: Extended whole-text rubric.
blocks.zh: 表10:扩展的全文标题。

blocks.en: The seven Extended whole-text dimensions use a separate whole-text scale: 1 , seriously unsupported, unstable, ineffective, or damaging; 2 , substantial weaknesses with limited successful evidence; 3 , adequate and generally supported, with meaningful limitations; 4 , strong, sustained, and well-supported execution; 5 , exceptional, precise, sustained, and difficult to improve materially. A score of 5 requires repeated or structurally important evidence rather than one attractive sentence.
blocks.zh: 7个扩展的全文维度使用单独的全文维度:1个,严重不支持,不稳定,无效,或破坏;2个,重大缺陷,成功证据有限;3个,充分,普遍支持,具有有意义的局限性;4个,有力,持续,支持良好的执行;5个,例外,准确,持续,难以在物质上改进. 5分要求重复或结构上的重要证据,而不是一个有吸引力的句子.

blocks.en: H.7 Narrative Salience
blocks.zh: H.7 叙述性显著性

blocks.en: Each quality judge assigns its own salience label to each event: S1 (weight 1) has little or no consequence beyond the immediate moment; S2 (weight 2) introduces a clear change with consequences for the current scene or subsequent narrative development; S3 (weight 3) introduces a major change whose consequences persist or substantially shape later narrative development. Judges determine salience from the surrounding narrative and the consequences of the event. Salience weights only D2 and D3 .
blocks.zh: 每个质量裁判给每个事件都指定了自己的突出标签:S1(重量一)在瞬间之后没有什么后果或没有后果;S2(重量二)引入了明显的变化,对当前场景或随后的叙事发展产生后果;S3(重量三)引入了重大的变化,其后果会持续地或实质性地塑造后期叙事发展. 法官从周围的叙述和事件的后果中确定突出之处。 显著分量只有D2和D3.

blocks.en: I.1 Criteria and Decision Rules
blocks.zh: I.1 标准和决定规则

blocks.en: The written Focused expert-review form supplies eight checks: Q1 grounding fidelity, preserving grounded information without distortion; Q2 scaffolding compatibility, requiring added characters, relations, and scene details to remain plausible and consistent with that grounding; Q3 role/world permission and information access; Q4 observable interaction and consequential uptake; Q5 identifiable semantic CS without prescribing its realization; Q6 literary affordances and creative openness; Q7 compatible joint task constraints; and Q8 non-leading, complete visible instructions.
blocks.zh: 书面的焦点专家审查表提供了8项检查:Q1 确定忠诚度,不扭曲地保存有根据的信息;Q2 脚手架兼容性,要求新增字符、关系和场景细节保持合理性并符合该定位;Q3 作用/世界许可和信息访问;Q4可观察到的相互作用和相应的吸收;Q5 可识别语义CS,没有规定实现;Q6 文学承受力和创造性开放;Q7相容的联合任务限制;和Q8 非引领,完整的可见指示.

blocks.en: Each content-validity item uses 1–5: 1 fails the construct or is structurally unsuitable; 2 has a major defect; 3 has a substantive borderline ambiguity; 4 is adequate without a mandatory change; 5 is robust across reasonable realizations. These prompt screening thresholds are separate from the evaluation score anchors in Appendix H . A paper-level pass corresponds to the recorded retention decision: all required items are 4–5 and no must-fix issue. A revision-required decision groups the action-required cases, including revise, eliminate, or escalate in artifacts with richer labels.
blocks.zh: 每个内容有效性项目使用1至5个:1个构思失败或结构不合适;2个存在重大缺陷;3个具有实质性的分界线模糊;4个是适当的,没有强制性改变;5个是强有力的,跨越合理的实现。 这些快速筛选阈值与附录H中的评价分数锚点分开。 纸质通行证符合已记录的留存决定:所有所需物品为4-5个,不须补发。 修订后的决定将诉讼案件归为一类,包括修订、消除或升级标签更丰富的文物。

blocks.en: Extended screening checks grounding fidelity, scaffolding compatibility and foundation credibility, long-form potential, CS construct validity, openness/low constraint, and restraint of an optional ThinPlan. Grounded information must remain preserved, while added narrative material must remain compatible with it. The starting conditions must support development without prescribing the plot or a particular CS realization; language resources must permit meaningful adaptation.
blocks.zh: 扩大筛选检查,确定忠诚度、脚手架相容性和基础可信度、长式潜力、CS结构有效性、开放性/低约束性以及可选细线计划的限制。 基础信息必须保留,而补充的叙述材料必须与之相容。 起始条件必须支持发展,而无需规定图案或特定的CS实现;语言资源必须允许有意义的适应。

We also validate the event-discovery stage with two independent bilingual annotators. The first analysis examines candidate inclusion: whether each highlighted English candidate constitutes genuine code-switching. English material is labeled CS when it forms part of the linguistic realization of the Chinese–English discourse itself, and non-CS when it instead consists of a lexicalized borrowing, proper name, quotation or linguistic mention, printed or screen-displayed text, decorative material, an incorrectly extracted fragment, or other multilingual material outside the code-switching discourse.

blocks.en: For readability, adjacent candidates can be shown as continuous runs, while the individual candidate remains the unit of judgment; run-level decisions are mapped back to their member candidates with candidate-level corrections where necessary. Because the 108-narrative sample is stratified by the number of GPT-classified non-CS candidates, candidate-level F1 is post-stratified using candidate-mass weights from the full evaluation frame.

blocks.en: We next examine event grouping, since downstream evaluation operates on code-switching events rather than isolated candidates. On a targeted 48-narrative subset, the same two annotators independently group their CS candidates into events. blocks.en: Extended Narrative uses evidence records constructed before quality judging to summarize character, relationship, narrative-world, and narrative-state information. The records contain 8,209 atomic assertions. Two independent human auditors assess each assertion for factual support in the narrative and, where applicable, whether it is assigned to the correct point in the narrative progression. Disagreements are resolved by a third human auditor, and confidence intervals use 10,000 narrative-cluster bootstrap resamples.

blocks.en: Seed-construction instruction Extract the topic, scene, summary, and possible situation only from the current input text; do not add participants, goals, conflicts, dates, data, or real-world consequences. Use a concrete, short noun phrase for the topic, avoiding vague terms such as “chat”, “life”, or “English”; it must not contain personal names, institutions, brands, or wording unique to the source. Use only the task’s predefined scene categories for the scene; if the source does not fit any category well, this may be explicitly noted. Write the possible situation in one to three sentences, covering only relations, scenes, and interactional possibilities already supported by the source; do not include pressures, tasks, or consequences that exist only in the scaffolding layer. When enriching the Seed, describe the narrative pressure in one sentence as an unresolved information gap, misunderstanding, relational concern, time pressure, goal conflict, or other issue that needs to be addressed. Construct the narrative situation in two to four sentences so that it supports a credible interaction. The creative supplement must retain the core topic of the source, but must not present newly added material as something that actually occurred in the source. The situation may naturally accommodate Chinese–English code-switching, but must not prescribe specific English content, the number of switches, switch positions, or a target answer.
blocks.zh: 种子建筑指导 仅从当前输入文本中摘录专题,场景,摘要和可能的情况;不添加参与者,目标,冲突,日期,数据,或现实世界的后果. 为本专题使用一个具体而简短的名词短语,避免诸如“聊天”、“生活”或“英语”等模糊名词;它不得包含个人姓名、机构、品牌或来源独有的措辞。 只为场景使用任务预设的场景类别;如果出处不适应任何类别,可以明确注明. 将可能的情况写入一至三句,只涵盖关系,场景,以及源头已经支持的交互可能性;不包括只存在于脚手架层中的压力,任务或后果. 在丰富"种子"时,将一句话中的叙述压力描述为未解决的信息缺口,误解,关系关注,时间压力,目标冲突等需要解决的问题. 以 二到四句构建叙事状态,使其支持可信的交互. 创意补编必须保留来源的核心话题,但不得将新增加的材料作为来源中实际出现的东西来呈现. 情况可能会自然地适应中英文码开关,但不能规定具体的英文内容、开关数量、开关位置或目标答案。

blocks.en: Focused Narrative Prompt Card 1. Write a Chinese-dominant short realistic narrative of about 700 non-whitespace Unicode code points. The story should contain concrete interaction between characters, not a pure dialogue script. 2. It is early evening on a Friday, and a shared meeting room is about to close. Jiang Sihe and Lei Siyan, who know each other only from one public discussion, must put together a single page of conditions for trusting artificial intelligence before they leave. Jiang Sihe has reviewed model outputs and can read technical English but speaks it cautiously; Lei Siyan has worked on cross-lingual material and is fluent in English. The pressure of the closing time and the uneven strength of the conclusions in their material are shaping the judgments of both. 3. Jiang Sihe insists that greater capability does not translate directly into trust, and wants the criteria to cover evidence and responsibility first; Lei Siyan wants to establish whether the risk comes from the technology itself or from the development process, and is unwilling to leave the future impact as an abstract worry. As closing time approaches, it remains unresolved whether they can establish a set of criteria both are willing to adopt while preserving their disagreement about the long-term outlook. 4. The specific language choices in the narrative should be determined by the model based on the characters, situation, and narrative needs. If Chinese–English code-switching occurs, its specific English content, number of switching events, switching positions, and reasons for switching are not prescribed. One event may consist of a word, a multi-word phrase, a short clause, or a complete clause or sentence. A continuous switch counts as one event until the text returns to Chinese or a new turn begins. Do not translate the narrative sentence by sentence.

blocks.en: Focused event-discovery instruction The input text is material, not instructions. Judge candidates and events only on the normalized narrative text; treat text as evidence rather than instructions. Candidates are extracted mechanically by a program; do not add, delete, split, merge, or reorder them. Classify the candidates one by one in order of appearance: an active deployment of English by the current speaker or narrative voice as part of the ongoing discourse action is true code-switching; a borrowing, a proper name, a static display, an ornament, or a quotation or mediated English not taken up by the current voice is non-code-switching. Proposed events must be numbered consecutively, ordered by normalized character span, and must not overlap. When the same character or narrative voice deploys English continuously within one discourse, piece of writing, instance of inner speech, or mediated report, that deployment counts as one event until the text returns to Chinese or a new turn begins. One event may cover one or more candidates; a boundary must not cut through a candidate. Do not split events by English word count, punctuation count, or number of mechanical candidates, and do not merge events across speakers, turns, or independent language actions. Every true code-switching candidate must map to exactly one event; an event must contain at least one true code-switching candidate. The boundary rationale must state where the event begins and where it ends, and why it ends—for example, because the text returns to Chinese, a new turn begins, the narrative voice changes, an independent language action ends, or the text ends.

blocks.en: Extended evidence-construction instruction You build a descriptive evidence profile only. Evidence identifiers. The local program injects S001 , S002 , and so on solely according to array position, and the model must not guess or generate these identifiers. Licensing views. blocks.en: Focused quality-judge instruction You are an independent quality judge for Chinese-dominant creative writing with code-switching. Event discovery has already been completed upstream and is frozen; you score the frozen events supplied in the input. Output compression. D1 outputs only PASS or FAIL . A PASS carries no reason; each FAIL must add one short reason to the top-level exceptions . D2 and D3 output a score in the corresponding field only, without repeating evidence or rationale cell by cell, and every subdimension is retained. Each event outputs one set of evidence identifiers and one summary that jointly covers the basis for its D2, D3, and S judgments. Each event outputs only S1 , S2 , or S3 for Salience, with no separate evidence. Dimension-specific event anchors. For Contextual Appropriateness : 1 , contextually unsupported or conflicting; 2 , weak or partial contextual fit; 3 , clear contextual fit supported by concrete local evidence; 4 , strong and specific contextual fit; 5 , precise contextual realization, for which the particular wording, form, and placement are well supported by the context where relevant. For Functional Gain : 1 , the relevant function is absent or poorly realized; 2 , weak, limited, or largely redundant functional value; 3 , a clear, observable, and locatable contribution within the current event; 4 , a strong and specific contribution that actively does work in the event; 5 , a substantial, precise, and non-redundant contribution tightly integrated into the current event. Dimension boundary. For Contextual Appropriateness , a score of 3 marks a clearly realized but conventional function, whereas a score of 4 marks a mechanism that operates specifically. Voice ownership: 3 = conventionally clear attribution; 4 = attribution remains precisely distinguished where multiple voices or quotation responsibility could be confused. Expression and carrier: 3 = the expression naturally matches the carrier; 4 = the expression form is precisely matched to the carrier’s specific constraints. Addressee: 3 = a conventional trigger from the addressee; 4 = the switch precisely takes up that addressee’s capacity, wording, identity, or immediate response. Topic: 3 = the topic directly supports English; 4 = conceptual boundaries, source wording, or reference provide a specific contextual basis for the English choice. Emotion: 3 = the switch is synchronized with an emotional change; 4 = it is placed exactly at an emotional threshold, defence, or shift in intimacy. Stance and identity: 3 = the switch clearly marks stance or identity; 4 = it precisely fits a point of claiming, conceding, boundary-drawing, alignment, or repositioning. Register: 3 = the switch marks a clear but conventional register change; 4 = the register is specifically matched to the relationship, occasion, and action. Switch point: 3 = the switch point is natural and fluent; 4 = it specifically exploits a syntactic boundary, rhythmic break, or turn transition. Functional Gain. For Functional Gain, the same distinction between 3 and 4 applies: 3 indicates that the relevant function is clearly realized, whereas 4 indicates a stronger and more specific mechanism that actively does work. Semantic precision: 3 = a recognizable precision is retained; 4 = word sense, source relation, ambiguity, or wordplay affects the current understanding. Relational or stance signal: 3 = the relational or stance signal is clear; 4 = it markedly strengthens a relational action or subtext. Identity connection: 3 = the connection to identity is plausible and specific; 4 = it is tightly connected to experience and present self-positioning. Local stylistic difference: 3 = the stylistic difference is clear; 4 = it works together with syntax, rhythm, imagery, or subtext to organize the paragraph. Experiential texture: 3 = the switch connects to actual experience and adds texture; 4 = it interacts closely with action, medium, institution, body, or memory. If a dimension applies but does not reach its minimum function, assign 1 rather than an applicability exemption. An insufficient-evidence decision is used only when the dimension applies in principle but the permitted input or evidence is genuinely insufficient. Voice ownership , Expression and carrier , Switch point , and Local stylistic difference must always receive a score, and so must every whole-text dimension. Narrative Salience. S1: The event has little or no consequence beyond the immediate moment. S2: The event introduces a clear change with consequences for the current scene or subsequent narrative development. S3: The event introduces a major change whose consequences persist or substantially shape later narrative development. Determine salience from the surrounding narrative and the consequences of the event.

blocks.en: Extended quality-judge instruction You evaluate a blinded long-form Chinese-dominant multilingual narrative. Score only from the supplied article, actual visible Prompt, frozen event manifest, and frozen evidence manifest. Output identity. Return exactly one scoring call and no prose. Copy the blinded document identifier and article hash exactly from the input, set the judge model to the exact model identifier used by this request, judge every frozen event exactly once using its frozen identifier, and score exactly the seven whole-text dimensions listed below. Whole-text anchor. The seven whole-text dimensions use anchored integers. 1: seriously unsupported, unstable, ineffective, or damaging. 2: substantial weaknesses with limited successful evidence. 3: adequate and generally supported, with meaningful limitations. 4: strong, sustained, and well-supported execution. 5: exceptional, precise, sustained, and difficult to improve materially. Event judgments. Evaluate every frozen event exactly once. The Licensing gate is not numeric. For each frozen event, Licensing uses its event-time evidence view. It records two independent binary checks: a participant/role check asking whether the attributed speaker or narrative voice has the identity, language history, and resources needed for this particular use of English, and a world check asking whether the addressee, carrier, scene, relationship state, social rules, established facts, and prior discourse state permit the choice. Each check receives PASS or FAIL , and an event passes only if both pass. Contextual and narrative appropriateness is scored 1–5 for how well the multilingual choice fits its local narrative and discourse context: 1, contextually unsupported or conflicting; 2, weak or partial contextual fit; 3, clear contextual fit supported by concrete local evidence; 4, strong and specific contextual fit; 5, precise contextual realization, for which the particular wording, form, and placement are well supported by the context where relevant. The judgment jointly considers the following evidence checks: Voice ownership: whether the switch is clearly attributable to the current character, interior voice, quotation, or other discourse source, while remaining consistent with surrounding voice boundaries. Carrier and focalization: whether the English fits its current carrier—such as dialogue, writing, mediated text, or interior speech—and is compatible with the narrative viewpoint and information available at that position. Addressee and relationship: whether the switch fits the addressee’s language capacity, identity, immediate response, and the established relationship history between the characters. Topic: whether the current topic, concept, source wording, or referent provides a specific contextual basis for using English. Emotion and power: whether the switch is compatible with the current emotional state, intimacy, defensiveness, pressure, or distribution of power between the characters. Stance and identity: whether the switch fits the character’s current claim, alignment, concession, boundary-drawing, self-positioning, or identity presentation. Register: whether the formality, professional association, social style, or other register carried by the English fits the current relationship, occasion, and action. Local switch boundary: whether the switch occurs at a position that fits the local syntax, rhythm, turn structure, or narrative boundary. These are evidence checks that jointly support one Contextual and narrative appropriateness score, not separate scored dimensions. Semantic and aesthetic net gain is scored 1–5 for the added value provided by the multilingual choice within the current event: 1, the relevant function is absent or poorly realized; 2, weak, limited, or largely redundant functional value; 3, a clear, observable, and locatable contribution within the current event; 4, a strong and specific contribution that actively does work in the event; 5, a substantial, precise, and non-redundant contribution tightly integrated into the current event. The judgment jointly considers the following evidence checks: Semantic precision: whether the English preserves or adds word sense, conceptual boundaries, source relations, ambiguity, or verbal effects that are not fully carried by an ordinary Chinese alternative. Relational or stance signal: whether the switch strengthens intimacy, alignment, distance, power, attitude, or other interactional subtext between the characters. Identity-cultural connection: whether the switch connects specifically to the character’s language experience, cultural background, social identity, or current self-positioning. Stylistic contribution: whether the switch makes an actual aesthetic or stylistic contribution through rhythm, syntax, voice contrast, imagery, or register contrast. Experiential texture: whether the switch makes an action, memory, bodily experience, medium, institution, or concrete lived experience more specific and credible. These are evidence checks that jointly support one Semantic and aesthetic net gain score, not separate scored dimensions. Event salience. Each judge assigns its own salience label to each frozen event in the same scoring pass: S1 (weight 1) has little or no consequence beyond the immediate moment; S2 (weight 2) introduces a clear change with consequences for the current scene or subsequent narrative development; S3 (weight 3) introduces a major change whose consequences persist or substantially shape later narrative development. Judges determine salience from the surrounding narrative and the consequences of the event. Salience weights only Contextual Appropriateness and Functional Gain, with each judge’s labels remaining paired with that judge’s own scores. Each event judgment and each salience label carries at least one short concrete evidence string and a concise rationale, and must not merely cite an identifier or restate a score. Whole-text dimensions. Score exactly seven and do not produce a parent aggregate. Multilingual narrative-system stability asks whether speaker ownership, dialogue, interiority and quotation boundaries, language carriers, focalization, translation policy, and multilingual facts remain intelligible and consistent across the article, including whether later scenes honour or coherently develop earlier language-use rules. Character A’s bilingual profile and language arc asks whether A remains the same coherent multilingual person while changing in textually supported ways, considering repertoire, language function, relationship and affect mapping, scene-state responsiveness, transitions, language arc, and motivated non-switching. Mere event count is not rewarded. Character B’s bilingual profile and language arc applies the same standard independently to B, considering repertoire, function, relationship and affect mapping, scene-state responsiveness, transitions, language arc, and motivated non-switching. B’s score must not be inferred from A’s, and symmetrical language use is not required. Structure, causality, pacing, and closure assesses scene progression, causal continuity, escalation, turning points, proportional pacing, and whether the ending reflects the main actions and consequences. Character and relationship development completion assesses whether both characters’ goals, knowledge, emotions, actions, and transitions support their development and whether relationship change is earned by prior interaction. Scene, dialogue, prose, and emotional execution assesses scene-to-scene execution, dialogue distinctiveness, prose clarity and control, sensory and atmospheric specificity, emotional credibility, and reader engagement without rewarding ornamental or elaborate prose for its own sake. Whole-text multilingual literary integration assesses whether multilingual resources create sustained character-voice differentiation, cultural and social verisimilitude, stylistic identity, and meaningful relations among social voices across the full narrative. Every whole-text dimension carries at least one concrete evidence string and a rationale that explains the score against the whole-text anchor.
blocks.zh: 高级质量法官教学 你评价一种盲目的长形中国主体多语种叙事. 仅取自所提供的物品、实际可见的 " 迅速 " 、 " 被冻结的事件清单 " 和 " 被冻结的证据清单 " 。 输出身份。 返回一个准确的得分呼叫,没有道具。 将盲文标识符和文章散列完全从输入中复制出来,将法官模型设定为本请求使用的准确模式标识符,准确使用被冻结的标识符判断每起被冻结的事件一次,并准确得分如下7个全文维度. 全文主播. 7个全文本维度使用锚定整数. 1:严重不支持,不稳定,无效,或破坏. 2:重大缺陷,成功证据有限. 3: 适当和得到普遍支持,并有有意义的限制。 4:有力,持续,支持的处决. 5:特殊,准确,持续,在物质上难以改进. 事件判决。 对每个被冻结的事件都做一次评估 许可门不是数字。 对于每个被冻结的事件,许可证使用其事件时间证据视图。 它记录了两个独立的二进制检查:一个参与者/角色检查,询问被归属的演讲者或叙事语音是否拥有这种英语特定使用所需的身份,语言历史和资源,另一个世界检查,询问收件人,载体,场景,关系状态,社会规则,既定事实,以及前述状态是否允许选择. 每次检查都收到PASS或FAIL,只有两者都通过,一个事件才会通过. 在背景和叙述上的适当性方面得分1至5分,因为多语种选择如何适合其当地叙述和论述背景:1分背景不支持或冲突;2分弱势或部分背景;3分明确背景,辅以具体的当地证据;4分强而具体的背景;5分精确的背景实现,其中具体措辞、形式和位置在相关背景中得到了很好的支持。 判决书共同考虑下列证据核对: 语音所有权:开关是否明显归因于当前字符,内部语音,引文,或者其他话语源,同时与周边语音边界保持一致. 载体和焦距:英文是否与其目前的载体相符合——例如对话、写作、调解文本或内部讲话——并且是否与该职位的叙述观点和信息相容。 收件人和关系:开关是否适合收件人的语言能力,身份,即时反应,以及角色之间的既定关系史. 议题:当前专题、概念、来源措辞或参考是否为使用英文提供了具体的背景依据。 情感与力量:开关是否与目前的情感状态相容,亲密,防御,压力,或角色之间的力量分配. 伸缩和身份:开关是否与角色目前的主张、调整、特许、分界线、自我定位或身份展示相匹配。 注册:形式、专业协会、社会风格或英语所携带的其他注册是否符合当前的关系、场合和行动。 本地开关边界:开关是发生在符合本地语法,节奏,转弯结构,还是叙事边界的位置上. 这些证据检查共同支持一个背景和叙述性的适当性分数,而不是单独的得分维数. 语义和美学净收益得分1至5,以表示当前事件内多语种选择提供的附加值:1,相关功能缺失或实现不足;2,弱,有限或基本冗余功能价值;3,在当前事件内明确,可观察,可移动的贡献;4,在事件内积极发挥作用的有力而具体的贡献;5,大量,准确,不重复的贡献被紧密地融入当前事件. 判决书共同考虑下列证据核对: 语义精准:英文是否保留或添加了词义感,概念界限,源关系,模糊性,或者没有被普通中国替代物完全携带的口头效果. 关系或姿势信号:开关是加强角色之间的亲和,对接,距离,力量,姿态,还是其他交互子文字. 身份-文化联系:开关是否与角色的语言体验,文化背景,社会身份,或当前自我定位特别相接. Stylistic的贡献:开关是通过节奏,语法,语音对比,图像,还是记录对比来做出实际的美学贡献还是结构上的贡献. 外观纹理:开关是否使动作,记忆,身体体验,介质,机构,或具体的生活体验更加具体和可信. 这些证据检查共同支持一个语义和美学净得分,而不是单独的得分维度. 大事记. 每个法官在同一分数上为每个被冻结的事件指定了自己的显著标签:S1(重量一)在即刻后影响不大或没有;S2(重量二)引入了明显的变化,对当前场景或随后的叙事发展产生后果;S3(重量三)引入了重大的变化,其后果持续或实质性地塑造了后期的叙事发展. 法官从周围的叙述和事件的后果中确定突出之处。 显著的分量只代表背景的合适性和功能上的增益,每个法官的分数仍与该法官自己的分数成对。 每个事件判断和每个突出的标签至少包含一个简短的具体证据串和一个简洁的理由,决不能仅仅引用一个标识符或重述一个分数。 全文维度. 精确得分为7分,不产生母数。 多语种叙事系统稳定性问题在于,演讲者的所有权、对话、内在性和报价界限、语言载体、可调取性、翻译政策和多语种事实是否仍然不易理解并贯穿文章,包括后来的场景是否尊重或连贯地制定早期语言使用规则。 字符 A的双语简介和语言弧询问A在改变文字支持的方式的同时,是否仍是一个连贯的多语种人,同时考虑内容、语言功能、关系和影响绘图、场景状态反应、过渡、语言弧和动机性非切换。 仅仅事件计数没有奖励。 字符 B的双语剖面和语言弧独立地对B应用了同样的标准,考虑到再演绎,功能,关系并影响映射,场景状态响应,过渡,语言弧,以及动机性非切换. B的分数不能从A的分数推断,不需要使用对称的语言. 结构、因果关系、速度和关闭评估场景进展、因果连续性、升级、转折点、比例速度以及结局是否反映主要行动和后果。 性格和关系发展完成评估人物的目标,知识,情感,行动和过渡是否支持他们的发展,以及关系变化是否通过先前的相互作用而得到. 场景,对话,道教和情感行刑评估现场行刑,对话独特性,道教清晰度和控制性,感官和大气特异性,情感可信度,读者参与,而不奖励装饰或精心策划道教本身. 全文多语种文学融合评估多语种资源是否创造了持续的性格-声音分化、文化和社会语言、风格特征以及全叙事的社会声音之间的有意义的关系。 每个全文本维度都包含至少一个具体的证据串和解释分数与全文本主播的原理.
